description: Calculate pizza dough in grams from the number of pizzas, the ball weight and hydration, with either fresh yeast or sourdough starter. Returns flour, water, salt, leavening and toppings, plus a link to the same recipe on loafy.ai. A loaf of bread is calculate_bread_dough. A value outside its range is corrected, and notes name it.

dough_type.description: Leavened with fresh yeast or with sourdough starter.

hydration_percent.description: Water as a percentage of flour. 55-65 is easy to handle, above 70 is expert.

oven.description: home is a domestic oven, pizza an Ooni or Roccbox, wood a wood-fired oven.

weight_per_pizza_g.description: Dough ball weight in grams. Left out, it follows the oven: 250 g home, 270 g pizza oven, 280 g wood-fired.

name: calculate_pizza_dough

ingredients.description: Flour, water, salt and the leavening (fresh yeast or starter), in grams.

input.description: The arguments as the tool used them, after any correction.

note.description: A remark on the whole result, such as why nothing was found.

notes.description: What was corrected or left out, such as a value outside its range.

toppings.description: Toppings for all the pizzas: grams, and basil as leaves and pots.

url.description: The same answer, recipe or entry on loafy.ai.

title: Pizza dough calculator
